features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: 64-Head Variable Drop Printhead System
items.desc: 64 industrial-grade printheads with 4 to 72 picolitre variable drop size deliver sharp fine detail, smooth gradients, and vibrant solid fills across the full 3200 mm print width at maximum production speed.

items.title: Qwizard Smart Operation System
items.desc: Intuitive production management interface with Wi-Fi remote control enables single-operator monitoring of jobs, machine status, and workflow scheduling from any connected device.

items.title: Heated Driven Pressure Roll with Fabric Spreader
items.desc: Advanced inlet system positions all fabric types accurately on the belt before printing, including elastic and stretch materials, significantly reducing fabric distortion and registration errors.

items.title: Anti-Crash Head Protection System
items.desc: Laser-beam sensors detect media unevenness ahead of the carriage and immediately prevent printhead contact with raised fabric surfaces, protecting heads at all operating speeds.

items.title: Automatic Belt Washing System
items.desc: Built-in inline double-brush belt cleaning system keeps the transportation belt free from ink buildup throughout production, minimising manual maintenance and downtime between shifts.

items.title: Inline Ink Degassing System
items.desc: Real-time air bubble removal from the ink circuit maintains consistent nozzle performance and print quality throughout extended high-speed production runs without operator intervention.

items.title: Uninterrupted Ink Supply System
items.desc: Ink tanks support live refilling during active printing, eliminating production stops for ink replenishment on high-coverage or long continuous-run jobs.

items.title: ACIMIT Green Label Certified
items.desc: Independently certified for reduced energy, water, and chemical consumption, supporting manufacturers with documented sustainability commitments for international buyer compliance.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Ultra High-Volume Fashion Textile Production
fabrics.desc: The highest-speed scanning printer in the MS range, purpose-built for large polyester fabric manufacturers supplying wholesale saree, dress material, and fashion textile markets at maximum daily output.

fabrics.title: Wide-Format Home Textile and Furnishing Production
fabrics.desc: 3200 mm print width handles extra-wide bedding, curtain fabric, upholstery, and large-format furnishing textiles without seam constraints that limit standard 1800 mm machines.

fabrics.title: Large-Scale Export Garment Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: Reactive printing on cotton at very high volume for major export facilities supplying international brands with consistent quality across large recurring orders.

fabrics.title: Flag, Banner, and Soft Signage Production
fabrics.desc: Extra-wide 3200 mm format makes the MiniLaRIO the ideal choice for manufacturers producing flags, exhibition banners, retail soft signage, and event textile applications at scale.

fabrics.title: Sportswear and Performance Fabric Printing
fabrics.desc: High-speed disperse and pigment output on stretch and technical fabrics for sportswear brands, gym wear producers, and performance apparel exporters serving high-volume order pipelines.

fabrics.title: Sustainable Export-Focused Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: ACIMIT Green Label certification provides documented resource efficiency proof for manufacturers supplying European and international buyers with environmental compliance requirements.

fabrics.title: Integrated Mills and Large Print Houses
fabrics.desc: Vertically integrated manufacturers and large dedicated print houses who need scanning-head versatility at volumes that match or exceed single-pass output requirements.
